game.name: Kane & Lynch : Dead Men (Japan)
game.desc: In the action game Kane & Lynch: Dead Men for Xbox 360, we follow the trials and tribulations of Marcus Adam, aka Kane, sentenced to death for the murder of 25 Venezuelans and recently escaped from prison thanks to the intervention of James Seth Lynch, an ultra-violent psychopath. It's up to you to play as these two characters during the 16 chapters of the Adventure mode.
